approved_decision.rule: HNK lexical forms may contain adjacent vowel phonemes, including VVV sequences. Exact syllable boundaries and hiatus/diphthong/glide realization remain unresolved until later gates.
approved_decision.rationale: FROZEN SARADAYA and TAYOVAN contain adjacent vowel sequences under affirmed G40=/y/; therefore a blanket ban on adjacent vowels is not compatible with stable corpus evidence.

governance_decisions.decision: Do not define a diphthong inventory in B2.
Do not define glide formation or allophonic /j/ in B2.
Do not assign lexical stress or canonical whole-word pronunciation in B2.
Treat the old blanket 'avoid hiatus' preference as historical authoring prior, not canonical phonological law.
B2 changes no phoneme identities, semantics, morphology, grammar, productivity or curriculum slots.
